gates.requirement: The exported tree is allowlisted, text-only, and scanned for high-confidence private material.
A private vulnerability-reporting route is documented.
The published CI workflow defines WebUI typecheck, unit tests, production build, bundle scan, and Chromium fixtures. This source-definition gate does not establish a successful hosted run.
The exact GPL-2.0 and BSD-licensed RTL8188FU source closure, notices, and corresponding source are recorded.
Two clean builds from documented public and owner-acquired inputs are byte-identical.
The exact firmware candidate passes management, media, browser, and resource acceptance.

A supported pre-write RAM path captures two complete original partition sets, and interrupted write, corrupt data, reset, reinstall, final-layout recovery, and same-device stock restoration pass on physical hardware with complete readback.
The model-universal build API accepts no camera private configuration, emits empty data provisioning, and two camera authorizations reference identical firmware bytes.

The separate exact-span camera JFFS2 is physically written and read back, its active removable-media transaction is passivated, and power interruption is accepted without changing the signed universal firmware artifact.
The published path passes on a second independently recovered DCS-6100LHV2 A1.
The macOS, Linux, and Windows host contracts pass CI; each claimed physical-media path still needs recorded removable-media acceptance.
The full Raptor source closure, notices, local patches, and corresponding-source delivery are reviewed together before distributing firmware.
